intent: Bring python_pkg/wsg_grabber/downloader.py under the 250-line file cap by splitting the Worker class's board-walking and file-fetching halves into mixins, keeping every method reachable as a bound attribute of Worker.
scope: Non-goal: no behaviour change, no test changes, no pylint config change
changes: Moved the board-walking methods -- _scan_step, _refresh_thread_list, _archive_refs, _conditional_get, _fetch_thread, _write_off_deleted -- into ScanMixin in _scan.py.

Added _worker_base.py holding WorkerBase(ABC): the state both halves touch, plus abstract _get_json / _publish / _wait_for_slot which Worker supplies. Both mixins inherit from it, so neither redeclares the other's bookkeeping.
Worker is now `class Worker(ScanMixin, DownloadMixin)`; __init__ is unchanged and remains the only place instance state is created.

verification.evidence: 277 passed in 15.20s, unchanged from before the split. This is the load-bearing check: test_downloader_part2.py calls worker._download_one() and worker._fetch_thread(ThreadRef(7, 100)) as bound methods and sets worker._catalog_fresh directly, so the mixin composition is exercised rather than assumed.

verification.command: pre-commit run --files python_pkg/wsg_grabber/downloader.py python_pkg/wsg_grabber/_scan.py python_pkg/wsg_grabber/_fetch.py python_pkg/wsg_grabber/_worker_base.py
verification.evidence: ruff, ruff format, mypy, pylint, bandit and the coverage-gated pytest all pass. The only remaining hook failures were 'no staged evidence artifact' and 'no workflow contract', which this file and the paired contract satisfy. No suppression was added.
All four files are under the cap: 238 / 134 / 98 / 52.

risks: Two intermediate designs failed the gate and were abandoned rather than suppressed. Bare `raise NotImplementedError` stubs on the mixins would have been uncovered lines under the 100% gate; `if TYPE_CHECKING` method stubs satisfied mypy but left pylint reporting no-member. The ABC with real abstract methods satisfies both.

_downloaded carries a class-level default of 0 rather than a bare annotation, because _fetch does `self._downloaded += 1` and pylint only accepts an attribute as assignable when there is something to assign to. Worker.__init__ still sets the instance value, so no state is shared between instances -- ints are immutable, so the class attribute is never mutated in place.

Mixin method resolution order now matters: Worker(ScanMixin, DownloadMixin) means ScanMixin wins on any name collision. There are none today; adding a same-named method to both would silently pick ScanMixin's.
rollback: git revert the commit; downloader.py returns to its 420-line form and the three new modules are deleted.
After rollback, run python3 -m pytest python_pkg/wsg_grabber/tests/ -q to confirm 277 tests still pass.
